claims: Actual entropy variational inequality for two probability laws of finite Mathlib relative entropy.
For |F| <= M nu-almost everywhere, squared difference of expectations <= 2 M^2 times real KL(mu|nu).
Dimension-free real Hilbert-valued version under ||F|| <= M.
AE conditional-kernel versions for actual Markov kernel probability laws.
proof_route: Tilt the reference law and apply Mathlib Gibbs inequality with the exact likelihood-ratio integral formula.
Use quadratic log-MGF bound and a discriminant argument valid also at zero variance.
Use Mathlib Hoeffding to derive bounded-observable Pinsker with sharp coefficient 2.
Test a Hilbert-valued observable against its expectation difference and cancel the nonzero squared norm.
explicit_hypotheses: Probability laws, finite KL(mu|nu), nonnegative M, AE measurability/strong measurability and nu-AE absolute-value/norm bound. Kernel statements assume these hypotheses base-almost everywhere. No target inequality assumed.
remaining_source_bridge: Integrating the conditional KL and identifying it with joint relative entropy or an entropy increment remains separate; no integral conditional-KL chain rule is claimed.
